children: Vulcan Infrastructure & Power closed a multi-part PIPE financing totaling approximately $39.3 million, selling Class A common stock to MIG, Atlas, Conversant and other investors at $1.71 per share. In tandem, the company issued a $10 million senior secured convertible PIK note and a three-year warrant to MIG, and granted investor rights to MIG and Atlas. The security and pledge agreements provide first-lien collateral on mining equipment and subsidiary equity tied to powered land in Columbus, Mississippi. Vulcan plans to use proceeds to redeem the remaining $33.1 million of 8.50% senior notes due October 2026 and for general corporate purposes, including project predevelopment.
